title: 달았자 뭐해
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. A nylon-string acoustic guitar plays a fingerstyle pattern with prominent bass notes and steady arpeggiation. A warm, melodic electric bass guitar follows the chord changes with smooth slides and legato phrasing. Male vocals are delivered in a soft, intimate baritone with a conversational cadence. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the fingerpicked guitar and the vocal melody. 72 BPM, Key of C Major, 4/4 time signature. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the proximity of the microphone to the singer and the guitar strings.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[soft baritone male vocals]
형광등 아래 [melodic electric bass enters]
우산들이 서 있다
4월에 누군가 두고 간 것
노란 줄기가 낡아 있다

[Verse 2]
아마 그날 비가 왔겠지
기억은 여기 남아 있다
6월의 하늘색 우산
반납기한 스티커가 붙어 있다
